description: Creates a Stripe Checkout session server-side and returns { checkoutUrl, product, sessionId }. Hand the URL to the user; payment completes on Stripe's hosted page. This never charges. product: permit_guide | certified_exam | unlimited_pass. permit_guide and unlimited_pass are county-specific (state + county required). Pass idempotencyKey so agent retries cannot double-create sessions.

county.description: Required for permit_guide and unlimited_pass (name or slug)

email.description: Buyer email, prefilled at Stripe Checkout

idempotencyKey.description: Client-generated key; retries with the same key reuse the Stripe session

state.description: Required for permit_guide and unlimited_pass (2-letter abbrev or slug)

name: start_checkout
title: Start Stripe Checkout
